notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Dockside Extortionist.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield on top of your library.
Activate Thrasios by paying {4}, causing you to scry 1, ensuring to leave Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library, and then drawing Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Repeat.
If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets near-infinite Treasure tokens.
